title: The Honest Merchant
text: A merchant on the otherworld road, plump and pleasant, behind a cart with a sign that reads HONEST PRICES. She means it. She is, unsettlingly, entirely honest, and out here that is the strangest thing any of you have seen.

options.label: Buy something good from her, and try not to wonder what the catch is.

outcomes.text: She asks a fair price for a fine thing. It feels like a trick, though it is not.

options.label: Sell her what you have spare, and count your coin twice.

outcomes.text: She counts out a fair price in front of you, which is unsettling in itself.

options.label: The wisest asks why she is honest out here, where nothing else is.

outcomes.text: She tells you, and it is the best advice you have had in years.
